heading.title: Of Offences Relating to Coin, Currency-Notes, Bank-Notes, and Government Stamps

article.title: Possession of forged or counterfeit coin, Government stamp, currency-notes or bank-notes
article.content:
180Possession of forged or counterfeit coin, Government stamp, currency-notes or bank-notes

Section 180 · Chapter X
Whoever has in his possession any forged or counterfeit coin, stamp, currency-note or bank-note, knowing or having reason to believe the same to be forged or counterfeit and intending to use the same as genuine or that it may be used as genuine, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, or with fine, or with both.
ExplanationIf a person establishes the possession of the forged or counterfeit coin, stamp, currency-note or bank-note to be from a lawful source, it shall not constitute an offence under this section.
